findings.passage: A vote for Sam is a vote for a stronger Democracy. I want to strengthen our Democracy by protecting the people’s right to vote by repealing SB 202 and other anti-voter laws; take money out of politics; and enact an independent redistricting commission.
findings.note: His answer to Ballotpedia's candidate survey, which the page says he completed in 2022. He names repeal of SB 202 (the 2021 Georgia election law with ID rules for absentee ballots) as one of his three key messages. Ballotpedia is the only place found for this text.

findings.passage: By safeguarding our voting rights and ensuring free, fair, transparent, and accessible elections, we uphold the values of equality and freedom, empowering every individual to actively shape the future of our country and pursue their own version of the American Dream.
findings.note: From the priorities page of his campaign site, written in the third person about what he believes. It speaks of voting rights and accessible elections in general and does not mention ID rules. The page shows no date.
